snippet.title: Azur Lane’s Eighth Wave is Here! New Commanders and Ships!
snippet.description:
Azur Lane’s Eighth Wave is here—and it's rolling in with one of the biggest drops of new content yet: eight new Commanders, six ships, three permanent camouflages, one enemy destruction effect, and the Azur Lane Comics collection with a 7-week combat mission marathon.

Reinforce your fleet and Commander roster, explore updated containers with new additions waiting inside, and take part in the event to complete the collection and claim its rewards.
